description_en: Retrieves a list of applications for full-link canary releases
description_zh: 获取应用列表，供全链路灰度拉取应用列表
name: ListApplicationsForSwimmingLane

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126249.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID。需要调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126249.html接口获取
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: Success.

3xx: Redirection.

4xx: Client error.

5xx: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

items.description_en: Information about an application in the list

BaseAppId.description_en: The ID of the baseline application

BaseAppName.description_en: The name of the baseline application

MseAppId.description_en: The ID of the MSE instance

MseAppName.description_en: The name of the MSE instance

MseNamespaceId.description_en: The ID of the namespace in which the MSE instance resides
MseNamespaceId.description_zh: MSE 实例所在的命名空间ID

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a canary tag

ServiceTags.description_en: The canary tags configured for the application

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

The parameter is an empty string if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码目录

Message.description_en:
The response message. Valid values:

success is returned if the request is successful.

A specific error code is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回 success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

RequestId.description_en: The trace ID used to query the details of a request
RequestId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
获取应用实例列表是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：表示获取成功。
false：表示获取失败
